answer_2.quote: Our method is able to recover 73.8% of the word tokens, substantially more than using the wordbank alone (40.8%). ... We also outperform a unigram baseline that selects lattice paths consisting of the most popular words to decipher non-wordbank cipher tokens (46.9%).

answer_4.quote: For tokens where our system output does not match the original plaintext, we asked an outside annotator to indicate whether our model captures the same meaning.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge whether the system output has the same meaning as the gold‑standard plaintext.
